name: Maintenance Services Contract
description: Standard contract for maintenance work carried out on District land.

blocks.text: This Contract is entered into on {{doc.date | date}} between {{org.name}} ("the District"), of {{org.address}}, and {{vendorName}} ("the Contractor").

blocks.emptyText: No parcels have been attached to this contract.

items: The Contractor shall perform the work described above in a workmanlike manner and in accordance with all applicable law.
Payment shall be made against purchase orders issued under this Contract and shall not exceed the contract value without a written amendment.
The Contractor shall carry insurance in the amounts required by the District and provide evidence of it before mobilising.
Either party may terminate this Contract on thirty (30) days written notice.
The District may inspect the work at any time and may withhold payment for work not performed to specification.
